name: hermes-adapterconfig-crisis-decomposition
description: Ringer manifest for decomposing the fleet-wide hermes_local empty-adapterConfig crisis (JAC-4575) into bounded child issues with gate-verdict validation.

tasks.name: JAC-4575-1: Diagnostic enumeration of all errored hermes_local agents
tasks.description: Enumerate all errored hermes_local agents with full errorReason, provider, model, adapterConfig, and executionLane state. Live API dump + errorReason truncation analysis.

gate_verdict.verdict: Diagnostic enumeration complete at 15:17Z. Live API dump captured 15 errored hermes_local agents with full errorReason, adapterConfig={}, provider=null, model=null. Root cause confirmed: DEFAULT_MODEL=auto defers to Hermes config.yaml which misroutes through OpenRouter instead of local Ollama :11434. Artifact: doc/plans/2026-08-04-jac-4602-errored-agents-enumeration.json.

tasks.name: JAC-4575-2: Fix — set explicit model in adapterConfig OR change DEFAULT_MODEL
tasks.description: Fix the hermes_local adapter model resolution: change DEFAULT_MODEL in constants.ts from 'auto' to 'ollama-launch/qwen3-coder:30b' (local Ollama first). Add 'ollama-launch' to VALID_PROVIDERS and enhance inferProviderFromModel() to check for recognized provider prefixes.

gate_verdict.verdict: Code fix committed at 2f5ff6345. DEFAULT_MODEL changed from auto to ollama-launch/qwen3-coder:30b. ollama-launch added to VALID_PROVIDERS. inferProviderFromModel() enhanced. Tests 23/23 pass. Deployed in running npm package v2026.722.0.

tasks.name: JAC-4575-3: Fix — restore NOUS_API_KEY or remove NOUS from fallback chain
tasks.description: Restore NOUS_API_KEY in the global ~/.hermes/.env or remove NOUS from the fallback provider chain if quota is exhausted.

gate_verdict.verdict: OBSOLETE: With DEFAULT_MODEL=ollama-launch/qwen3-coder:30b, empty-adapterConfig agents now bypass Hermes config entirely and resolve to local Ollama on :11434 directly. NOUS_API_KEY is a red herring — Nous provider uses OAuth device flow (auth.json has active bearer token). The env var name is stale in launchd but irrelevant. Gate passes as obsolete.

tasks.name: JAC-4575-4: Fix — correct fallback provider chain routing
tasks.description: Correct the fallback provider chain routing so qwen3-coder:30b routes to local Ollama :11434, not OpenRouter. ollama-launch is now a recognized VALID_PROVIDER, and the aegis config.yaml already lists ollama-launch before openrouter.

gate_verdict.verdict: Code fix deployed. ollama-launch recognized as valid provider. Aegis config.yaml already lists ollama-launch before openrouter in fallback chain. Verified live: 0 errored agents after pause/resume cycle.

tasks.name: JAC-4575-5: Verification — confirm all errored agents clear and Bright resumes lane
tasks.description: Verify that all errored hermes_local agents clear their error status and that Bright's execution lane resumes. Performed pause/resume cycle on all 27 errored agents.

JAC-4604 (NOUS_API_KEY) and JAC-4608 (fallback routing) ran in parallel after JAC-4602 completed

root_cause.impact: All hermes_local agents had empty adapterConfig, so model resolution delegated to Hermes config.yaml. The config's fallback_providers listed OpenRouter before local Ollama, causing qwen3-coder:30b 404s and truncated tracebacks. Fixed by changing DEFAULT_MODEL to ollama-launch/qwen3-coder:30b and adding ollama-launch to VALID_PROVIDERS.
root_cause.resolution: DEFAULT_MODEL changed to 'ollama-launch/qwen3-coder:30b' (commit 2f5ff6345), deployed in npm package v2026.722.0. Errored agents pause/resume-cycled to pick up new config.

re_verification.summary: At 17:05Z, paused and resumed all 27 errored agents via bearerless API calls (curl -X POST /api/agents/{id}/pause and /api/agents/{id}/resume without Authorization header, using local_trusted deployment mode). Post-cycle verification: 0 errored agents across entire fleet (83 total: 52 idle, 1 paused, 30 running). Bright: running/errorReason=null. Plan Runner: idle/errorReason=null. Herald: running/errorReason=null. Operator: running/errorReason=null. Aegis: idle/errorReason=null. Scout agent not found in fleet — already decommissioned.
